entry.title: Olive Oil and Orange Salad
entry.summary: Sliced oranges dressed with olive oil, salt, and black pepper. A Sicilian classic.

entry.title: Peanut Butter and Pickle Sandwich
entry.summary: The viral sweet, salty, and sour sandwich. Do not knock it until you try it.

entry.title: Smoked Salmon and Cream Cheese Cucumber Rolls
entry.summary: Thin ribbons of cucumber wrapped around smoked salmon and cream cheese.

entry.title: Butter Mochi Bites
entry.summary: Sweet, chewy Hawaiian butter mochi cubes. A dense, satisfying treat.

entry.title: Mochi and Matcha Tea
entry.summary: A sweet Japanese snack of chewy mochi served with a frothy matcha latte.

entry.title: Antipasto Skewers
entry.summary: All the flavors of an antipasto plate, threaded onto skewers for easy eating.

entry.title: Zucchini Noodles with Pesto
entry.summary: Tender zucchini noodles tossed with basil pesto and parmesan make a light, quick dinner for one.

entry.title: Quesadilla with Sweet Potato and Black Beans
entry.summary: A hearty vegetarian quesadilla filled with mashed sweet potato and beans.

entry.title: Gnocchi with Pesto and Cherry Tomatoes
entry.summary: Pillowy potato gnocchi tossed in basil pesto with burst cherry tomatoes.

entry.title: Caprese Stuffed Avocado

entry.title: White Bean and Tuna Salad

entry.title: Cheddar and Apple Quesadilla
entry.summary: A sweet and savory quesadilla with sharp cheddar and crisp apple slices.

entry.title: Dark Chocolate and Almond Butter Banana Bites
entry.summary: Slices of banana topped with almond butter and dark chocolate chips.

entry.title: Baked Sweet Potato with Marshmallows and Pecans
entry.summary: A dessert-like dinner. A sweet potato baked until soft, then topped with marshmallows and pecans.

entry.title: Cucumber and Feta Salad with Dill
entry.summary: Cool cucumber, briny feta, fresh dill, and red wine vinegar make a crisp salad that improves as it rests.

entry.title: Fig and Gorgonzola Flatbread
entry.summary: Sweet figs and sharp gorgonzola melt together on a crisp flatbread finished with honey and black pepper.

entry.title: Baked Eggs in Avocado
